verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the SigNoz UI. SigNoz's AI features are an MCP server and Agent Skills, which let external agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Codex) query data and manage dashboards. Those agents run outside the product, so this is adjacent support that belongs to the MCP/integration stories, not a built-in assistant you delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
